5d096e0116466e199b7f04f672036286.overview: In the midst of a volatile regime change in a Francophone African state, Maria Vial is fighting to sustain her family’s coffee plantation. With rebels and the army struggling for control, French peacekeeping forces move out, warning the remaining white residents that they’re on their own. But Maria refuses to be driven off the land, even as tragedy looms.
5d096e0116466e199b7f04f672036286.tagline: In the African heat, one woman stands alone

5d0df9d7d4c8335681fe4db9cd60a269.overview: Turner, a black American soldier, is given three days leave in Paris. Not knowing what to do with himself, he goes to a nightclub where he meets a French girl named Miriam. Their romance blossoms, but their love affair is darkened by Turner's impending departure and the specter of racial prejudice.

5d11b314b454a29270b3c33c4f16e575.overview: Shakespeare's King Lear is reimagined as a singular historical epic set in sixteenth-century Japan where an aging warlord divides his kingdom between his three sons.
5d11b314b454a29270b3c33c4f16e575.tagline: In a mad world, only the mad are sane.

5d125b0040edc1e66b27da90ae7e1901.overview: Teenager Riley's mind headquarters is undergoing a sudden demolition to make room for something entirely unexpected: new Emotions! Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear and Disgust, who’ve long been running a successful operation by all accounts, aren’t sure how to feel when Anxiety shows up. And it looks like she’s not alone.

5d207c94c069f2acc431e918e9b1ce01.overview: The Freelings' suburban home becomes the center of paranormal activity that opens a portal to the 'other side'. With help, they must cross over to get their daughter back.

5d26a8ea15a459c1513817ead06becb1.overview: Having recently found God, self-effacing young nurse Maud arrives at a plush home to care for Amanda, a hedonistic dancer left frail from a chronic illness. When a chance encounter with a former colleague throws up hints of a dark past, it becomes clear there is more to sweet Maud than meets the eye.

5d3eaf997ca6f98a9dd55f1d199f40c8.overview: Constable Benton Fraser, an officer of the Royal Canadian Mounted Police, is attached to the Canadian consulate but works with Chicago Police Department to solve crimes.

5d4392fd1176189709558b3b8b1dca1d.overview: A samurai answers a village's request for protection after he falls on hard times. The town needs protection from bandits, so the samurai gathers six others to help him teach the people how to defend themselves, and the villagers provide the soldiers with food.

5d4fe842ec0f5832b76471a2c554ba81.overview: Seeking a divorce from her absentee husband, Mimi Glossop travels to an English seaside resort. There she falls in love with dancer Guy Holden, whom she later mistakes for the corespondent her lawyer hired.

5d557ef45d5432d26d84e810067af3c0.overview: Filmmaker Martin Bell chronicles the life of Erin Blackwell, mother of 10 children, from the time she was a 14-year-old prostitute through her battle with drug addiction, poverty and parenting.

5d577b52298f0bfe45da06d2fd9f11c1.overview: An ex-convict tries to connect with the daughter who doesn't even know he exists.
5d577b52298f0bfe45da06d2fd9f11c1.tagline: His was a life of the past...theirs of the future!

5db2f25ae012f1e991b2bd5f7d16191f.overview: Walter Lee Younger is a young man struggling with his station in life. Sharing a tiny apartment with his wife, son, sister and mother, he seems like an imprisoned man. Until, that is, the family gets an unexpected financial windfall.
5db2f25ae012f1e991b2bd5f7d16191f.tagline: The prize-winning drama that warms the screen with its people and its passions...

5dba441bc4e9d9e632a5d750ce88353f.overview: A documentary on the life and career of one of the most influential film directors of all time, Steven Spielberg.

5dd542c35a896164b0cd27631901517e.overview: Several friends travel to Sweden to study as anthropologists a summer festival that is held every ninety years in the remote hometown of one of them. What begins as a dream vacation in a place where the sun never sets, gradually turns into a dark nightmare as the mysterious inhabitants invite them to participate in their disturbing festive activities.

5dd6846e2c648ebe242d7ea2749bb471.overview: Diana Guzman, a troubled Brooklyn teenager, decides to channel her aggression by training to become a boxer, all while keeping it a secret from her father.
